title: Hide/unhide an existing comment on an owned video
content_data:
Use this endpoint to hide or unhide an existing comment on an organic video posted by an owned TikTok Account. > **Note**
> - Unhiding a comment might not always take effect due to factors such as moderation actions, user privacy settings, or other system-level filters. In these scenarios, the comment will remain hidden. To verify the current visibility status of a comment, you can either subscribe to the relevant comment webhook event or retrieve the comment's status (`status`) by making a request to the [/business/comment/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1760232109619202) endpoint. > - The comment webhook event [comment.update](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515104773122) enables you to get notifications within five minutes of a comment or reply being hidden or unhidden on any public video associated with an owned TikTok account. To subscribe to the comment webhook, see [Subscribe to the comment update event](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810521730276354#item-link-Subscribe%20to%20the%20comment%20update%20event). ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/business/comments/hide/|/v1.3/business/comment/hide/| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/comment/hide/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{20%}|Data Type{10%}| Param Location{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- |--- | | business_id {Required} | string | Body | Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.
Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041) to this field.| | comment_id {Required} | string | Body |Unique identifier for comment on an owned TikTok video to hide/unhide. This can be accessed via the [/business/comment/list/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1760232109619202) endpoint as the `comment_id` for each comment listed. | | video_id {Required} | string | Body | Unique identifier for owned TikTok video. This can be accessed via the [/business/video/list/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228421622786) endpoint as the `item_id` for each video listed. | |action {Required} | string | Body | Specific operation to be performed on the comment - hide or unhide.

Enum values: `HIDE`, `UNHIDE`.

Example: `HIDE`. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/comment/hide/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "business_id" : "{{business_id}}", "comment_id" : "{{comment_id}}", "video_id": "{{video_id}}", "action": "HIDE" }' (/code) ``` ## Response **Header** These are important headers to record for issue reports and troubleshooting. This is not an exhaustive list of response headers. ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | Date | string | Date and time (GMT) when the response was received.
Example: Fri, 13 Aug 2021 08:04:42 GMT | | X-Tt-Logid | string | Unique identifier for the API request. | ``` **Body** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| | request_id | string | Unique identifier for the API request.

Please record this field for all API requests. Important for issue reports and troubleshooting. | | code | Integer | Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message| string | Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | | data | object | Returned data.
Empty object (`{}`) for successful actions. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "Ok", "request_id": "20210817034316010245031056097316BA", "data": {} } (/code) ```
